hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT-backed token pools that applies a decaying buy fee (starting at 95%, dropping to a 15% flat fee over blocks) and a flat 15% sell fee. Fees are taken via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converted to ETH via nested swaps when needed, and distributed to a FeeContract vault, founder wallets, or used to buy-and-burn a configurable brand asset token.
